description: This file defines a Drupal class 'Cookie' that implements cookie-based authentication and event subscription for handling user sessions, redirects, and login checks.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: A Drupal class implementing cookie-based user authentication and event handling for session management and redirects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cookie authentication provider with session configuration, database connection, and messenger services.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Checks if the current request applies for session-based authentication, and adds an error message if cookies are not accepted.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Retrieves the user session based on the current request's session.

methods.name: getUserFromSession
methods.description: Loads user data from the database based on session UID and returns a UserSession object if valid.

methods.name: addCheckToUrl
methods.description: Adds a 'check_logged_in' query parameter to redirect URLs during login to verify successful login.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the addCheckToUrl method as a listener for kernel response events.
